import { rankingView, rankingFooter } from '@src/response/leaderboard/view';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import App from '@src/response-apps/battle/leaderboard/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const currentUid = e.uid as number;
  const match = (e.MessageText ?? '').match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?战力排行榜(?:\s*(\d+|榜首|附近|我的))?$/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }
  const page = /^\d+$/.test(match[2] ?? '') ? Number(match[2]) : 1;
  const result = await App({ bid, uid: currentUid, page });

  if (result.code === 'LOCKED') {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '战力排行榜', realmName: result.data.realmName });

    return;
  }
  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '战力排行榜', content: md }));

    return;
  }
  const { time, totalPages, total } = result.data;
  const view = rankingView(e.MessageText ?? '', result.data.self !== null);
  const list = view.nearby ? result.data.nearby : result.data.list;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (time) {
    const d = new Date(time);
    const pad = (n: number) => (n < 10 ? `0${n}` : String(n));

    md.addText(`统计时间：${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`);
  } else {
    md.addText('统计时间：暂无（首次统计中）');
  }
  md.addNewline();
  if (result.data.building) {
    md.addText('榜单更新中');
    md.addNewline();
  }
  md.addText(
    result.data.self
      ? `我的排名：第${result.data.self.rank}名 · 战力${result.data.self.power}`
      : result.data.complete
        ? '暂无个人战力排名'
        : '个人排名正在统计中'
  );
  md.addNewline();
  if (list.length === 0) {
    md.addText('当前暂无榜单数据，正在统计中，请稍后查看');
  }
  for (const item of list) {
    const buttons: { label: string; command: string }[] = [{ label: '查看', command: `/查看信息 ${item.uid}` }];

    if (result.data.canUseSpar && currentUid !== item.uid) {
      buttons.push({ label: '比试', command: `/比试 ${item.uid}` });
    }
    if (currentUid && currentUid !== item.uid) {
      buttons.push({ label: '点赞', command: `/点赞人气 ${item.uid} battle` });
    }
    md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([`【${item.rank}】${item.name ?? '未知玩家'}`, `ID:${item.uid} 战力✊${item.power}`], buttons));
  }
  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '战力排行榜',
      content: md,
      header: [
        { label: '全服', command: '/战力排行榜' },
        { label: '本区', command: '/区战力排行榜' }
      ],
      footer: rankingFooter('/战力排行榜'),
      nav: !view.nearby && totalPages > 1 ? { current: result.data.page, total: totalPages, count: total, command: '/战力排行榜 {page}' } : undefined
    })
  );
});
